data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** b5caaf81832ee5f23ad9f160bd7b4ff7b8e9e854
* **Context Scope:** .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When child bug tickets were filed under an epic during a sprint session (not as implementation stories), the CLI should provide a way to detach or reparent them so the epic can be closed independently. Either a `--force` flag on `ticket transition ... closed`, a `ticket reparent <id> <new-parent>` command, or a `ticket unlink-parent <id>` command should exist.

#### Actual Behavior

Running `.claude/scripts/dso ticket transition <epic-id> in_progress closed` when 2 open child bug tickets exist exits with:
```
Error: cannot close ticket '<epic-id>' while it has 2 open child ticket(s).
Close the following children first:
02fc-901d-b806-4d61
925d-804c-385d-4cfa
```

The `ticket edit` command does not accept a `--parent` field. No `ticket reparent` or `ticket unlink-parent` subcommand exists. The only options are: close all children first, or leave the epic open. This forces premature closure of legitimate open bugs that belong to a different scope.

### 3. Action History

1. Attempted `ticket transition <epic-id> in_progress closed` — blocked by open children
2. Attempted `ticket link <child> <epic> relates_to` — rejected as "redundant link" (already parent-child)
3. Checked `ticket edit --help` — no `--parent` field available
4. Checked ticket CLI reference — no reparent/unlink-parent subcommand documented
data.title: ticket transition: closing epic with open child bugs -> blocked with no reparent/force option
